ORIGINAL USMLE-STYLE PRACTICE

Melatonin: 5

A patient starts melatonin for new insomnia but also recently changed work shifts and began a stimulating medication. Before escalating the supplement, which clinical assessment helps identify modifiable causes of the altered sleep pattern?

  1. Stop the suspected causative drug and arrange urgent supportive care
  2. Monitor renal function and manage rhabdomyolysis risk
  3. Review medication exposure and symptom timing
  4. Treatment-resistant schizophrenia
  5. Continue clinically indicated ANC monitoring
Answer and explanation

Review medication exposure and symptom timing

A careful history of new drugs, dose changes and withdrawal helps distinguish medication syndromes from other causes.

Option explanations

Review medication exposure and symptom timing: A careful history of new drugs, dose changes and withdrawal helps distinguish medication syndromes from other causes.

Treatment-resistant schizophrenia: Clozapine has a particular role after adequate trials of other antipsychotics have failed, under specialist management. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

Continue clinically indicated ANC monitoring: Removal of the US clozapine REMS did not remove the risk of severe neutropenia or the need for monitoring in prescribing guidance. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

Stop the suspected causative drug and arrange urgent supportive care: Suspected NMS requires urgent assessment, withdrawal of the causative agent and supportive management; severe cases may need specialist therapies. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

Monitor renal function and manage rhabdomyolysis risk: Marked CK elevation and myoglobin release can cause acute kidney injury in severe muscle injury. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
